[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested exercises for shoulders:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Arnold Press: A variation of the dumbbell press that targets the anterior deltoids.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Lateral Raises with Rotation: Hold dumbbells at your sides, lift them out to the sides until shoulder height, rotate shoulders so palms face forward, then lower.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Rear Delt Fly: Hold dumbbells, bend knees slightly, lean forward, lift dumbbells out to the sides until shoulder height.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Face Pulls: Use a resistance band or cable machine to perform face pulls, targeting rear deltoids.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested exercises for legs:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Bulgarian Split Squats: Hold dumbbells, stand with back to a bench, place one foot on the bench behind you.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Step-Ups: Use a bench or step, hold dumbbells, step up with one foot, then step back down.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Calf Raises on a Step: Stand on a step, raise onto tiptoes, then lower back down.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Sumo Deadlifts: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, hold a dumbbell or barbell, lift weight to hip level.
